title: Israeli operation in Jabalya and siege of northern Gaza
body:
The Israeli military announced on 6 October 2024 that an operation had begun the night before in Jabalya, in northern Gaza, and, according to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), it had tightened a siege on the north since 1 October. OCHA reported over 50,000 people displaced from the Jabalya area in two weeks, and said others remained stranded in their homes. Humanitarian Coordinator Muhannad Hadi said on 13 October that civilians must not be forced to choose between displacement and starvation.

OCHA reported that no humanitarian food aid had entered northern Gaza since 2 October, as all crossings were closed. Between 1 and 14 October, 49 percent of 285 coordinated humanitarian movements were denied access. Kamal Adwan, Al Awda and the Indonesian Hospital operated at minimum capacity, and none of the 25 primary health-care centres in North Gaza were functional. OCHA estimated about 175,000 people lived in North Gaza governorate as of 1 October.

The Gaza Ministry of Health reported 379 people killed and 1,423 injured between 8 and 15 October, and a total of 42,344 killed and 99,013 injured since 7 October 2023. The Israeli military reported five soldiers killed in Gaza between 8 and 15 October.
